2609.05111.title: Unifying ICL, SFT, KL-Regularized RL Through a Bayesian Lens
2609.05111.paper_summary: Large language models are now trained and evaluated under a diverse set of paradigms: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), few-shot in-context learning (ICL), KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR, on-policy distillation (OPD), and test-time reasoning with search and chain-of-thought. These methods are often discussed as fundamentally different, and recent empirical results--such as the mixed impact of few-shot prompting on RL-tuned reasoning models--can appear puzzling. This note develops a Bayesian perspective that puts these procedures on the same footing. At the core is a two-step template: (i) construct a (generalized) Bayes or Gibbs posterior q* over outputs or actions given a context, using a prior/reference model and a utility signal (log-likelihood, reward, or advantage); and (ii) approximate q* by a forward-KL projection onto a parametric family, either in-weights (SFT/RL) or in-context (ICL). Part I formalizes few-shot ICL and SFT as amortized and-weights projections onto the Bayes posterior predictive. Parts II-IV show that KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR, reward-weighted SFT, reward-weighted ICL (RW-ICL), and advantage-weighted SFT (AWSFT) are all instances of forward-KL projection onto posteriors induced by rewards or advantages. We disentangle where these equivalences hold (objectives and first-order updates) and where they do not (source and granularity of the learning signal). Part V sketches implications for modern reasoning pipelines: RLHF/RLVR recipes as "posterior design + projection", why cold-start or supervised warm-up is practically unavoidable for importance-weighted KL projections, and DeepSeek-R1 and o1-style reasoning models as combining test-time Bayesian search with training-time KL amortization.
2609.05111.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型現在在多樣的範式下進行訓練和評估：監督微調 (SFT)、少量上下文學習 (ICL)、KL正則化的RLHF/RLVR、政策內蒸餾 (OPD)，以及帶有搜索和思考鏈的測試時推理。這些方法常被討論為根本不同，最近的實證結果——例如少量提示對RL調整推理模型的混合影響——可能顯得令人困惑。這篇筆記發展了一種貝葉斯觀點，將這些程序放在同一基礎上。核心是一個兩步驟的模板：(i) 構建一個（廣義的）貝葉斯或吉布斯後驗 q*，根據上下文給出輸出或行動，使用先驗/參考模型和效用信號（對數似然、獎勵或優勢）；(ii) 通過對參數族的前向KL投影來近似 q*，無論是在權重內（SFT/RL）還是在上下文中（ICL）。第一部分將少量 ICL 和 SFT 形式化為對貝葉斯後驗預測的攤銷和權重投影。第二至第四部分顯示，KL正則化的RLHF/RLVR、獎勵加權的SFT、獎勵加權的ICL (RW-ICL) 和優勢加權的SFT (AWSFT) 都是對由獎勵或優勢引起的後驗的前向KL投影的實例。我們解釋了這些等價性成立的地方（目標和一階更新）以及不成立的地方（學習信號的來源和粒度）。第五部分勾勒了對現代推理管道的影響：RLHF/RLVR食譜作為“後驗設計 + 投影”，為什麼冷啟動或監督暖啟動在重要性加權的KL投影中實際上是不可避免的，以及DeepSeek-R1和o1風格的推理模型作為將測試時的貝葉斯搜索與訓練時的KL攤銷相結合。
2609.05111.author: Junxin Fan et.al.
